subject: Emergency subcontractor onboarding: DPA redlines + exception request
body:
From: Elise Chong <elise.chong@roverdata.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-legal@roverdata.com
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: add subcontractor for data migration (expedited) + DPA redlines

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on onboarding. We have an urgent request: our integration partner, ClearTransit LLC, needs to be added as an authorized subcontractor to support a one-week migration window starting 3/22. They will only process customer metadata (no raw customer content) and will store logs in their EU region.

Attached: RoverData_Subproc_Addendum_20250315.docx and Rover_DPA_Redline_20250315.pdf (redlines from our side).

Can Redwood provide an exception/accelerated approval path? We can produce the SOC2 report and a limited controls matrix by EOD Monday. Also attaching a proposed minimal access list for the migration.

Appreciate an expedited legal + compliance check — our project is on a hard cutover.

—Elise
Elise Chong
Head of Partnerships | Rover Data Systems
elise.chong@roverdata.com

---

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elise Chong <elise.chong@roverdata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add subcontractor for data migration (expedited) + DPA redlines

Thanks Elise — looping in Legal (Kimberly) and Procurement (Priyom).

Quick asks from our side to triage:
- Please confirm exact scope: datasets, retention window, and whether any PII will be accessible.
- Provide SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) and the controls mapping you mentioned.
- Confirm ClearTransit’s EU hosting location and whether encryption keys are customer-managed.

We will do a rapid assessment; if Procurement/Legal grant an exception it will be conditional on limited access, a short-term order-form amendment, and a signed DPA addendum.

Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elise Chong <elise.chong@roverdata.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add subcontractor for data migration (expedited) + DPA redlines

Hi team,

I reviewed the vendor redlines and the proposed addendum. High-level: I am open to a short-term exception but only under the following conditions (legal must sign off on the final language):

1) Limited-scope clause in the Order Form that explicitly references the migration timeframe (start/end dates) and that ClearTransit has no right to retain customer data beyond 7 days post-migration.
2) DPA addendum must include:
   - Data minimization and purpose limitation language (we must restrict processing to metadata and migration logs only).
   - Binding subcontractor flow-down (ClearTransit must bind its sub-suppliers to the same DPA terms).
   - Right to audit / evidence delivery: signed SOC2 Type II report or an equivalent report, and a mapping that ties controls to our critical controls list.
   - Data location assurance and encryption details; if keys are not customer-managed, require key rotation logs and proof of encryption-at-rest and in-transit.
3) Insurance and indemnity carveouts limited to migration only.

Attached is a quick redline summary: I highlighted clauses that must remain and suggested language for the Order Form amendment. Procurement should confirm commercial limits (credit hold, liability cap) before we finalize.

Attachments: Kimberly_Redline_Summary_20250315.pdf (excerpts)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elise Chong <elise.chong@roverdata.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Mar 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add subcontractor for data migration (expedited) + DPA redlines

Procurement note: RD-1247 (migration engagement) — we can approve an exception for ClearTransit for the one-week window under these commercial conditions:
- No change to the existing Order Form financial terms; this is an operational addon.
- Vendor must accept a temporary liability cap equal to the order value times 1.5 for the migration period.
- Signed addendum (DPA) and DocuSign envelope before any credentials are issued.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II (latest) + a signed controls attestation by ClearTransit. Delivery deadline: EOD Mon 3/17.

If all items are delivered on time Procurement will sign off and we will enable credentials.

Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

---

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elise Chong <elise.chong@roverdata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Mar 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add subcontractor for data migration (expedited) + DPA redlines

Elise — thanks, team has a path forward. To summarize next steps and timeline:

Action items for Rover Data Systems (due EOD Mon 3/17):
- Share SOC2 Type II report + control mapping (PDF).
- Confirm ClearTransit will accept the limited-scope Order Form amendment and the DPA redlines Kimberly proposed (we need a signed DocuSign envelope).
- Confirm data residency and whether encryption keys are customer-managed.

Our deliverables (Redwood) once evidence is received:
- Finalize and send a DocuSign envelope for the short-term Order Form amendment + DPA addendum.
- Procurement (Priyom) will countersign upon receipt of evidence.
- Security (Sean) will run a brief access checklist before credentials issuance and coordinate with Ops for IP allowlisting.

If you can get the evidence in by EOD Monday we can meet the 3/22 migration start. Otherwise we will need to postpone to the following week.

Sofia

---

From: Elise Chong <elise.chong@roverdata.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-legal@roverdata.com
Date: Mon, 17 Mar 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add subcontractor for data migration (expedited) + DPA redlines

Hi Sofia,

Thanks — attaching a stub of the signed order form (RD1247_OrderForm_Signed_stub.pdf). Vendor legal confirms ClearTransit accepts the limited scope and will sign the DPA addendum; SOC2 Type II is attached (separate secure transfer) and control mapping will be uploaded to the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow.

Question: can Redwood share the DocuSign envelope now so we can route internally and get countersigned by ClearTransit legal?

Best,
—Elise

Attachments referenced in thread:
- RoverData_Subproc_Addendum_20250315.docx (proposed addendum from Rover)
- Rover_DPA_Redline_20250315.pdf (vendor redlines)
- Kimberly_Redline_Summary_20250315.pdf (Redwood legal summary)
- RD1247_OrderForm_Signed_stub.pdf (vendor-signed stub)

Thread notes: internal coordination included legal (kimberly_park) for redline control, procurement (priyom_das) for commercial exception, security (sofia_ivanova, sean_gallagher) for evidence requirements and access gating. Final step: DocuSign envelope and credentials handover once evidence arrives.
